bio: There are several reasons why you feel at home here: first, there is the charming decor, which is fresh and contemporary yet retains a certain regional flavour, plus the terrace with a lovely view over the lake. Secondly, the food – you can expect cuisine that, although of a regional bent, is also open to international influences. Served in the form of a five- to eight-course set menu, the dishes, such as octopus, cauliflower, Amalfi lemon, saffron or lamb, meadow herbs, tomato, romaine lettuce, always have a modern, creative twist. And then there are your friendly hosts Jakob and Lilly Lilg, who make sure each guest feels well looked after....
